name: snap
summary: Installs applications packaged in the Snap format.
description: Canonical’s package system, preinstalled on Ubuntu. A snap bundles all its dependencies and runs in an isolated environment (confinement); snaps update themselves automatically. On the other hand, they take more space and sometimes start more slowly than apt packages. The catalog is on snapcraft.io.

options.description: Installs without confinement: needed for tools that must access the whole system (code editors, compilers).
Release channel: stable, candidate, beta, edge.

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: Lists installed snaps with their version and channel.

subcommands.name: find
subcommands.description: Searches for a snap in the catalog.

subcommands.name: info
subcommands.description: Details a snap: description, channels and available versions.

subcommands.name: refresh
subcommands.description: Updates a snap, or all of them without an argument.

subcommands.name: revert
subcommands.description: Goes back to a snap’s previous version.
